## Activity

During June 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 165 captures. Activity was completed through the site’s scheduled sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded capture volume provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 165 captures, 13 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.9. These images could not proceed through grading and are reported separately from the graded results. The ungradable total should be considered when reviewing the overall performance of the service and the quality of images submitted during the period.

## Grading

Grading identified 24 referable results from the captures reviewed. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the usual grading process was completed with a short interval between capture and review. Overall, the activity record for June 2020 comprises 165 captures, with image quality and grading outcomes documented above.
